issues.label: medium
issues.summary: Whitespace/dot chainIds still hit the chain collection endpoint; the `!chainId` guard only stops the empty string, and nothing tests the other values
issues.evidence: config-api.service.ts:78 only checks falsiness. Running `new URL('https://cfg/api/v1/chains/' + ' ')` or `'.'` in node gives `/api/v1/chains/`. `Number(' ')` is 0, so NumericStringSchema also accepts `' '` (a URL-encoded %20), and the collection-page 502 is still reachable even on the patched message routes. The new spec only tests `''`.

issues.label: medium
issues.summary: Of the four routes that gained pipes, only getMessageByHash has 422 tests
issues.evidence: The integration spec diff (around line 485) adds two tests, both for GET chains/:chainId/messages/:messageHash. The PR description says the empty-chainId case is parametrized across all four routes, but that is not what the diff does. Removing a pipe from any of the other three routes would not fail any test.

issues.label: low
issues.summary: The datasource guard silently changes empty-chainId responses on the 38 unvalidated routes from 502 to 404, and the PR description does not mention it

issues.label: low
issues.summary: The datasource-level check contradicts the stated 'lower layers trust their callers' design and partly duplicates the controller pipe
issues.evidence: The PR description says nothing changes below the controller, yet config-api.service.ts:75-80 adds a presence check. The check does protect the unvalidated routes, so it is not purely redundant; the cost is that the design split is inconsistent and undocumented.

issues.label: low
issues.summary: The pipes use NumericStringSchema rather than ChainIdSchema, which contradicts the PR description and drops the length bound
issues.evidence: messages.controller.ts:66/103/147/192 use NumericStringSchema. The description says ChainIdSchema is used and lists changes to chain-id.schema.ts and space-safes that are not in the diff. Other route-param pipes (8 files) also use NumericStringSchema, so this is consistent with existing code, but it leaves CHAIN_ID_MAXLENGTH unenforced.

issues.label: low
issues.summary: messageHash is typed `Hash` but validated with HexSchema, which accepts any length including '0x'
issues.evidence: hex.schema.ts only refines with `isHex`, so '0x' or '0x1' passes at messages.controller.ts:67/193 and still costs one upstream 404. The effect is minor: a wasted call and an overstated type, not a failure.

issues.label: low

issues.evidence: NumericStringSchema accepts ' ' (Number(' ') === 0), which new URL still collapses to the collection path. Stricter validation there is reasonable, but the specific proposal is incomplete.
